clips.summary: Horizontal center cropping to a 4:5 aspect ratio cuts off narrative elements and characters on the screen edges.

findings.observation: Cropping the 1280x720 source horizontally to 576x720 (4:5) eliminates the cottage on the left and crops characters entering from the right, leaving the dog partially cut off and the cat and mouse completely off-screen.

suggestions.reason: Preserve the original 16:9 framing so all sequential characters and background elements remain fully visible.

limitations: Assessment based on visual frame inspection; audio streams are absent.

clips.summary: Editorial subtitles rendered via subtitleForceStyle are placed in the lower-middle frame, occluding the main characters and crowding the existing burned-in subtitle bar.

findings.observation: Bottom-centered subtitle placement (Alignment=2, MarginV=70) renders editorial text directly across the turnip and character bodies, visually obstructing the primary subject action.

suggestions.reason: Reposition editorial subtitles to top-center (Alignment=8) with sufficient vertical margin to sit cleanly within the sky area without obscuring the characters or header.

limitations: Assessment based on visual frame inspection; audio streams are absent.

clips.summary: Editorial titles are cleanly placed in the upper safe region below the top banner and above character heads, with no framing or aspect ratio issues.
